feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 12 October 2026 8:38am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 12 October 2026 at 8:40am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure in the Atlantic will drive frontal troughs across the area today.


##Wind##

South or Southeast 5 or 6, decreasing 4 or 5 later this morning or early afternoon. Increasing South 5 or 6 this evening then South or Southwest 6 or 7 at first tonight, although staying a force or two lighter in Liverpool Bay and Morecambe Bay. Veering West or Southwest 5 or 6 occasionally 7 in all waters late in night or at first tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, building moderate or rough tonight.


##Weather##

Patchy light rain and drizzle today, with areas of mist and fog developing for a time. Heavy rain for a time later tonight, becoming fair later in night.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor, very poor in any fog.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or Southwest 5 or 6 occasionally 7, decreasing Southwest 4 or 5 for a time overnight into Wednesday, backing South or Southwest 5 or 6 late in night or at first on Wednesday morning.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, becoming moderate.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, otherwise fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
